# Airborne_Link_Diversity

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of multiple, heterogeneous connectivity options (cellular and satellite) simultaneously or selectively to maintain robust communication for UAVs in varied environments. Supports resilient multi-path topologies in TCC, where redundancy across different physical layers reduces single-point failures in aerial networks.
